# Contributing to Lansing Codes

Thanks for your interest in contributing! Whether you're fixing a bug, adding a
feature, or improving documentation, we appreciate the help.

## Getting started

See the [README](../README.md#getting-started) for setup instructions.

## How to contribute

1. Fork the repository and create a branch from `main`.
2. Make your changes.
3. Run `npm run lint` and `npm run build` to verify everything passes.
4. Open a pull request against `main`.

## Pull requests

- Keep PRs focused — one bug fix or feature per PR.
- Write a clear title and description explaining what changed and why.
- If your PR changes the UI, include a screenshot or brief description of the
  visual change.

## Reporting bugs

Open an issue on GitHub with:

- A clear title and description.
- Steps to reproduce the problem.
- What you expected to happen vs. what actually happened.

## Code style

- The project uses ESLint and TypeScript. Run `npm run lint` before submitting.
- Follow the existing patterns in the codebase — look at nearby files for
  examples of how things are structured.

## Questions?

For general questions, join the
[Lansing Codes Slack team](http://slack.lansing.codes). The issue tracker is
for bug reports and feature requests only.
